parameters.help_en: The business date. This is generally 00:00:00 of the day before the scheduled instance trigger time, in millisecond-level timestamp format, such as 1743350400000

parameters.name: biz_date

parameters.help_en:

- SmokeTest: Testing

- TriggerWorkflow: Trigger-based workflow

parameters.help_en: The ID of the workflow to which the instance belongs
parameters.name: workflow_id

parameters.name: ids

parameters.help_en: The account ID of the owner
parameters.name: owner

parameters.help_en:
The list of sort fields. Sorting by trigger time, start time, and other fields is supported. The format is "sort field + sort order (Desc/Asc)" (Asc can be omitted). Valid values of the sort field:

- TriggerTime (Desc/Asc)

- StartedTime (Desc/Asc)

- FinishedTime (Desc/Asc)

- CreateTime (Desc/Asc)

- Id (Desc/Asc)

Default value: Id Desc
parameters.help_zh:
排序字段列表，支持定时时间、开始时间等字段。格式为"排序字段+排序方式(Desc/Asc)"（Asc可以缺省）。排序字段的枚举值如下：
- TriggerTime (Desc/Asc)
- StartedTime (Desc/Asc)
- FinishedTime (Desc/Asc)
- CreateTime (Desc/Asc)
- Id (Desc/Asc)

默认值：Id Desc

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10

parameters.name: tags

parameters.help_en: The filter. In JSON format, multiple filter conditions have an AND relationship. Currently supported fields are: `status, executionDate`
parameters.help_zh: 过滤器。JSON格式，多个过滤条件之间是"且"的关系。目前支持的字段有：`status, executionDate`
